what: Kit pieces replaced by fal.ai 3D models. tools/fal_models.py makes a concept picture with 'prompt', turns it into a textured model (Hunyuan3D), then fits it: 'fit': 'piece' fills exactly the box of the hand-built piece it replaces; otherwise 'height_m' tall, pivot at its 'pivot' (top = hangs from the roof, bottom = stands on the floor), at most 'max_tris' triangles. It writes meshes/<piece>.glb and the model's colour map to textures/<material>/source.png. blender/hh_kit.py uses meshes/<piece>.glb instead of the hand-built piece whenever it exists. 'collision': 'hull' adds one convex collision hull.
style: single object fully visible and centered, isolated on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, photorealistic, highly detailed

SM_Heart.prompt: a monstrous giant rotting heart, dark crimson wet muscle covered in thick swollen veins and pale fat, great vessels rising from the top, horror creature organ

SM_Bone_Pile.prompt: a low wide heap of old human skulls and bones lying on the ground, yellowed and stained with dirt

SM_Crate.prompt: an old wooden cargo crate with iron corner brackets, wet dark weathered planks, faded stencilled lettering, cube shaped

SM_Barrel.prompt: an old rusty steel oil drum, dented, streaks of rust and dark oil stains

SM_Bunk.prompt: an old iron-framed two-tier ship crew bunk bed, two stacked narrow beds one above the other, thin stained mattresses, crumpled grey wool blankets

SM_Valve_Wheel.prompt: a round rusty iron valve hand wheel with five spokes and a central hub, seen from the front, just the wheel

SM_Table.prompt: an old heavy wooden ship mess table, rectangular, worn scratched top, thick legs

SM_Chair.prompt: an old wooden chair with a straight back, worn and scratched

SM_Sea_Chest.prompt: an old sailor's wooden sea chest with a rounded lid, iron straps and a padlock, weathered

SM_Rope_Coil.prompt: a coil of thick old frayed ship rope lying flat on the ground, wet and dirty

SM_Sacks.prompt: a pile of three old burlap grain sacks lying on the ground, dirty and damp
